name: Flood
overview: The Flood narrative in Scripture reveals God's righteous judgment on a world filled with violence and corruption, as He declared the coming destruction of all flesh (Genesis 6:13, 6:17). Noah, found righteous in his generation, was preserved through God's provision of the ark (Genesis 7:1). After the waters receded and the earth was renewed, Noah's worship and God's promise not to curse the ground or destroy all living creatures again demonstrate both God's justice and His mercy toward mankind despite human sinfulness (Genesis 8:5, 8:20-21). This account underscores God's sovereign control over history and His faithfulness to His covenant.
